# Offsetease

> Offsetease sources, screens and supplies high-integrity carbon, develops projects at the source, and turns ESG data into defensible disclosure. One partner, one standard of integrity, across carbon and sustainability.

Offsetease works across two connected areas: sourcing, screening and
developing high-integrity carbon supply, and turning ESG data into
disclosure that survives assurance. Based in India, serving India, the EU
and global markets.

## Start here

- [Home](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/): What we do, and the integrity standard we hold supply to.
- [About](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/about): How we work and what we stand for.
- [Sources & data](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/sources): Every statistic on this site with its named, dated source. Verify figures here.

## Carbon

- [Carbon Supply](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/carbon-supply): Spot, managed portfolio and offtake supply, screened against The Five Checks.
- [Energy Attribute Certificates](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/energy-attribute-certificates): I-RECs and EACs for Scope 2 reduction.

## ESG & sustainability

- [ESG & Sustainability](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/esg-sustainability): The full service index — eighteen services across five groups.
- [Measure](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/esg-measurement): GHG inventories, product carbon footprints, life cycle assessments and Environmental Product Declarations — the measured evidence every target, disclosure and carbon claim is built on.
- [Report](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/esg-reporting): BRSR and BRSR Core, CSRD and ESRS, IFRS S1 and S2, and the double materiality assessment underneath them — sustainability disclosure built to survive assurance.
- [Certify & score](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/esg-certification): EcoVadis ratings, CDP scores, CBAM and EUDR compliance and ISCC certification — the assessments and regulations that decide whether you can bid, sell or export.
- [Target & reduce](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/net-zero-targets): Science-based target setting and validation, and costed net-zero and decarbonization pathways — targets grounded in an inventory that holds up.
- [Strategise & manage risk](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/esg-strategy-risk): ESG and CSR strategy, climate risk and TCFD assessment, and supplier and value-chain ESG — the work that connects disclosure to decisions.

- [GHG accounting](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/ghg-accounting): The audited emissions baseline every target, disclosure and carbon claim is built on.

- [Double materiality assessment](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/double-materiality-assessment): What matters — to the business, and to the world.

- [EUDR](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/eudr-compliance): Deforestation-free, proven to the plot.

- [Net zero & decarbonization](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/net-zero-decarbonization): A pathway your CFO will finance.
- [ESG & CSR strategy](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/esg-csr-strategy): Purpose tied to the business, not bolted on.

## Insights

- [All insights](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/insights): Referenced analysis on the rules reshaping carbon and ESG.
- [CBAM strategy for iron & steel: what exporters must decide in 2026](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/cbam-iron-steel-strategy): CBAM is now a carbon price at the EU border for steel — the widest scope, the highest emissions. Verified data vs default values, and how to turn it into an edge.
- [CBAM in 2026: the definitive period, the Omnibus simplification, and what exporters must do now](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/cbam-definitive-period-2026): From 1 January 2026 the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism stops being a reporting exercise and becomes a cost. What changed, who is now exempt, and the moves that protect your margin.
- [SBTi's Corporate Net-Zero Standard V2: what the draft changes — and how to prepare](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/sbti-net-zero-standard-v2): The Science Based Targets initiative opened a draft of Version 2 of its Corporate Net-Zero Standard. It is not final — but the direction is clear, and target-setting companies should prepare now.
- [CDP after the overhaul: one questionnaire, IFRS-aligned, and how to score well](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/cdp-disclosure-2026): CDP consolidated its separate questionnaires into a single, IFRS-aligned disclosure on a new platform. How the system now works, how scoring is decided, and what actually moves your grade.
- [BRSR Core explained: India's assured sustainability disclosure and the value-chain ripple](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/brsr-core-assurance-india): India's BRSR has moved from narrative to assured data. BRSR Core requires reasonable assurance on a defined set of KPIs — and pushes ESG requirements down to unlisted suppliers.
- [LCA, PCF and EPD: which one your buyers are actually asking for](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/lca-pcf-epd-difference): As carbon requirements move from the company to the product, three acronyms dominate procurement conversations. They are related but not interchangeable — and choosing wrong wastes months.
- [EUDR explained: deforestation-free supply chains, plot-level geolocation, and the deadline](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/eudr-deforestation-regulation-explained): Seven commodities banned from the EU market unless proven deforestation-free and traceable to the plot. What EUDR demands — and how to prepare.
- [How EcoVadis scoring really works — and how to move from Bronze to Gold](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/ecovadis-scoring-bronze-to-gold): EcoVadis scores suppliers on four themes, with medals on a percentile curve. What the score really rewards — and how to move from Bronze to Gold.
- [ISCC EU vs ISCC PLUS vs CORSIA: which certification your business needs](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/iscc-eu-plus-corsia-which-certification): ISCC EU, PLUS, CORSIA and Carbon Footprint serve different markets. How to choose the right certification — or the right combination.
- [Scope 3 emissions: why they are most of your footprint and how to actually measure them](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/scope-3-emissions-measurement): Scope 3 is typically 70–90% of your footprint and the hardest to measure. The 15 categories, the methods that work, and where to start.
- [IFRS S1 and S2 explained: the global baseline for sustainability disclosure](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/ifrs-s1-s2-issb-explained): IFRS S1 and S2 are the global baseline for sustainability and climate disclosure. What they require, who must comply, and how to prepare.
- [High-integrity carbon credits: ICVCM, VCMI, and how to avoid the headline risk](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/carbon-credit-integrity-icvcm-vcmi): The carbon market has split on integrity — ICVCM defines the credit, VCMI the claim. What separates a quality carbon asset from a liability.
- [Funding the net-zero transition: building a pathway your CFO will actually finance](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/net-zero-pathway-funding): The gap between a net-zero pledge and a funded plan is a cost curve, a capital plan and financing. How to build a business case the board approves.
- [I-RECs explained: how energy attribute certificates cut your Scope 2 — credibly](https://kishan0088.github.io/Offsetease_V4.4/i-rec-renewable-energy-certificates): I-RECs let companies claim renewable electricity and cut market-based Scope 2 worldwide. How they work — and what makes a claim hold up.

## Notes for machine readers

- Figures on this site are dated and attributed; the source for each is
  listed on the Sources & data page. Cite the primary source where one is
  named, and check the review date — these numbers move quarterly.
- Regulatory detail (CBAM, EUDR, BRSR, CSRD, IFRS S1/S2, SBTi) reflects the
  position as at 2026-09. Verify against the
  primary regulator before relying on it.
- This site does not provide legal or financial advice.
